definition: Unique users who engage with the app or website learning area each day
formula: Reported quarterly mean of daily unique users
population_and_window: All product users in reporting quarter
limitation: Company wide and not Video Call usage; methodology may change

definition: Unique users who engage with the app or website learning area each month
formula: Reported quarterly mean of three monthly unique user counts
population_and_window: All product users in reporting quarter
limitation: Not quarter-end monthly users or unique users over the whole quarter

definition: Share of current user DAUs who return next day; current users were also active another time in prior seven days
population_and_window: Current user DAUs; exact aggregation window not disclosed
limitation: Only selected disclosure available; not new-user D7 or D30 retention

definition: Unique paying accounts with active subscription at period end
population_and_window: Paying subscription accounts at period end
limitation: Excludes trial users and nonpaying family members; stock versus average users

definition: Amounts received for purchases of Duolingo subscriptions
population_and_window: All subscription purchases in reporting quarter
limitation: Not GAAP subscription revenue; timing differs

definition: Subscription bookings plus advertising networks and English Test purchases and virtual goods IAP
population_and_window: All company bookings in reporting quarter
limitation: Not GAAP revenue and not Video Call revenue

definition: Revenue recognized under US GAAP in the reporting quarter
population_and_window: All company revenue in reporting quarter

definition: Quarterly average DAU divided by quarterly average MAU
population_and_window: All product users in same quarter
limitation: Analyst-derived; not mean of monthly stickiness ratios and not cohort retention

definition: GAAP recognized revenue from subscriptions in the quarter
formula: Reported subscription revenue in financial statements
population_and_window: All subscription revenue in reporting quarter
limitation: Not subscription bookings; confirm consistent segment line across quarters

definition: Share of target accounts entitled to use Video Call
formula: 100 * eligible target accounts / all target accounts
time_grain: as-of date by tier and market and platform
limitation: Official disclosure is qualitative only; exact numerator and denominator require internal entitlements

definition: Share of eligible assigned accounts completing at least one Video Call within seven days
formula: 100 * accounts with completed call within 7 days / all assigned eligible accounts
population_and_window: Eligible assigned accounts including zero-use accounts
limitation: Requires entitlement and completion events; never infer from rollout statements

metric: 28-day spoken words per assigned eligible account
definition: Active spoken words over 28 days divided by assigned eligible accounts
formula: Total validated spoken words in 28 days / all assigned eligible accounts
population_and_window: Eligible assigned accounts including zero-use accounts
limitation: Activity proxy not proof of learning gain; requires speech-event quality checks

definition: Intent-to-treat difference in day-30 activity between randomized groups
formula: 100 * (active treatment accounts / assigned treatment accounts minus active control accounts / assigned control accounts)
population_and_window: All randomized eligible accounts in both groups
limitation: Needs true randomization and stable activity definition; cannot derive from CURR

metric: 90-day incremental net contribution per assigned account
definition: Intent-to-treat difference in mean 90-day user contribution
formula: Mean of recognized user revenue less variable costs in treatment minus same mean in control
population_and_window: All randomized eligible accounts in both groups
limitation: Requires billing and refunds and AI costs and fees; no public feature-level values
